params.name: direction

params.name: to

params.name: senses_blocked

settings.name: module

params.name: engine
params.doc: Engine version the world was written for.

params.name: api_version

params.name: checkpoint_minutes
params.doc: Minutes between routine database checkpoints.

params.name: start_room
params.doc: Room label where new characters start.

params.name: plugins

params.doc: Single characters that stand for an engine command, such as {"'": "say"}.

constants.name: ALL
constants.doc: All perception and spell channels: sight, sound, noise, spell.

hooks.name: on_enter
hooks.doc: Fires after an actor enters the room.

ctx.name: ctx
ctx.doc: The context of one hook invocation.

fields.name: actor
fields.doc: The actor performing the action, or the damage/kill source.

fields.name: affect
fields.doc: The affect, for affect on_tick and on_expire.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: The damage dealt, for on_damage.

fields.name: args
fields.doc: A command's argument text, or a timer's keyword arguments as a dict.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: The movement direction name, for enter and exit hooks.

fields.name: elapsed_pulses
fields.doc: Pulses spent dormant, for on_wake.

fields.name: event

fields.name: from_room
fields.doc: The room the actor came from, for enter hooks.

fields.name: item
fields.doc: The item being picked up, dropped, used or given.

fields.name: proposals
fields.doc: For think: behavior proposals, best first.

fields.name: pulse
fields.doc: Game time.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Why the affect ended, 'expired' or 'removed', for affect on_expire.

fields.name: rng
fields.doc: The seeded random number generator.

fields.name: room
fields.doc: The room the event happens in.

fields.name: self
fields.doc: The hook's owner.

fields.name: skill
fields.doc: The skill being cast, for before_cast, on_cast_start and on_cast.

fields.name: source_room
fields.doc: For on_nearby: the room the event happened in.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: The target actor, or the target item of use and item skills.

fields.name: targets
fields.doc: Opponents, for on_combat_tick.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: Spoken text, for on_say and on_tell.

fields.name: to_room
fields.doc: The room the actor is going to, for exit hooks.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: The damage type, for on_damage.

fields.name: via_exit

fields.name: weapon
fields.doc: The weapon used in an attack, or None for unarmed.

methods.name: act
methods.doc: Queues a command line for a mob, exactly as if it typed it.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that acts.

params.name: command_line
params.doc: The command line, as a player would type it.

methods.name: act_advance
methods.doc: Queues one step along the room track toward target for a mob.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that acts.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor or item in the same room to step toward.

methods.name: act_attack
methods.doc: Queues an attack against target for a mob.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that acts.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor to attack.

methods.name: act_cast
methods.doc: Queues casting a skill for a mob.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that acts.

params.name: skill
params.doc: Skill label to cast.

params.name: target
params.doc: Target actor or item, or None for the skill's default target.

methods.name: act_move
methods.doc: Queues a move through an exit for a mob.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that acts.

params.name: dir
params.doc: Direction of the exit to take.

methods.name: act_retreat
methods.doc: Queues one step along the room track away from target (or toward the room back) for a mob.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that acts.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor or item to step away from, or None to step toward the back of the room.

methods.name: after
methods.doc: Calls fn(ctx, **args) on this hook's owner after some pulses. fn must be a top-level function; args must be storable.

params.name: pulses
params.doc: Pulses to wait, at least 1.

params.name: fn
params.doc: Top-level function fn(ctx, **args) to call.

params.name: args
params.doc: Keyword arguments passed to fn; values must be storable (int, str, bool, list or dict).

methods.name: allies_near
methods.doc: Actors of the same side (players with players, mobs with mobs) within a band who are not fighting actor.

params.name: actor
params.doc: The actor whose allies are wanted.

params.name: band
params.doc: Maximum distance: 'melee', 'near' or 'far'.

methods.name: apply_affect
methods.doc: Attaches a timed buff or debuff; re-applying a name replaces it.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor to receive the affect.

params.name: name
params.doc: Affect name; applying the same name again replaces the existing affect.

params.name: duration
params.doc: Duration in pulses.

params.name: stat_deltas
params.doc: Stat adjustments while the affect lasts, such as {'dex': -1}.

params.name: flags
params.doc: Flags the affect grants, such as 'no_regen'.

params.name: tick_every
params.doc: Pulses between on_tick calls, or None for no ticking.

params.name: on_tick
params.doc: Top-level function fn(ctx) called every tick_every pulses.

params.name: on_expire
params.doc: Top-level function fn(ctx) called when the affect expires or is removed.

params.name: expire_msg
params.doc: Text sent to the target when the affect ends.

params.name: modifiers
params.doc: Rules modifiers active while the affect lasts, by modifier point name.

methods.name: cancel
methods.doc: Cancels one of this owner's timers; True if it was pending.

params.name: timer_id
params.doc: Timer id returned by ctx.after.

methods.name: clear_active
methods.doc: Removes a set_active reason from an entity.

params.name: entity
params.doc: Actor, item or room.

params.name: reason
params.doc: The reason given to set_active.

methods.name: clear_anchor
methods.doc: Removes a set_anchor reason from an entity.

params.name: entity
params.doc: Actor, item or room.

params.name: reason
params.doc: The reason given to set_anchor.

methods.name: close_door
methods.doc: Closes an open door in direction dir.

params.name: room
params.doc: Room, or room label, that has the exit.

params.name: dir
params.doc: Direction of the exit.

methods.name: damage
methods.doc: Deals damage directly (no to-hit roll, no mitigation); fires on_damage.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor to damage.

params.name: amount
params.doc: Hit points of damage.

params.name: type
params.doc: Damage type, such as 'fire' or 'slash'.

params.name: source
params.doc: Actor credited with the damage, or None.

methods.name: del_attr
methods.doc: Deletes an attribute key from an entity.

params.name: entity
params.doc: Actor, item or room.

params.name: key
params.doc: Attribute key; unprefixed keys are in your package's namespace.

methods.name: deny
methods.doc: Vetoes the action; return it from a before_* hook.

params.name: msg
params.doc: Text shown to the actor whose action is refused.

methods.name: destroy
methods.doc: Removes an item and everything inside it.

params.name: item
params.doc: Item to remove from the world.

methods.name: echo
methods.doc: Sends text to everyone in a room, except the actors in exclude.

params.name: room
params.doc: Room, or room label, to send the text to.

params.name: text
params.doc: Text to send.

params.name: exclude
params.doc: Actors who don't receive the text.

methods.name: emote
methods.doc: The room sees '<actor> text'.

params.name: actor
params.doc: Actor performing the emote.

params.name: text
params.doc: Text that follows the actor's name.

methods.name: enemies_near
methods.doc: Opponents of actor within a band ('melee', 'near', 'far').

params.name: actor
params.doc: The actor whose opponents are wanted.

params.name: band
params.doc: Maximum distance: 'melee', 'near' or 'far'.

params.name: label
params.doc: Prototype label to look for.

params.name: scope
params.doc: Where to look: 'room', 'zone' or 'world'.

methods.name: get_attr
methods.doc: Reads a value; your own keys by short name, other packages' by 'namespace:key'.

params.name: entity
params.doc: Actor, item or room.

params.name: key
params.doc: Attribute key; your own by short name, another package's as 'namespace:key'.

params.name: default
params.doc: Value returned when the key is absent.

methods.name: give

params.doc: Actor who receives the item.

params.name: label_or_item
params.doc: Item view to move, or item prototype label to spawn.

params.name: count
params.doc: Number of items to spawn when given a label.

methods.name: heal
methods.doc: Restores hit points to target, up to max_hp.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor to heal.

params.name: amount
params.doc: Hit points to restore.

methods.name: here

params.doc: Keyword to match, as a player would type it.

methods.name: lock_door
methods.doc: Closes and locks the door.

params.name: room
params.doc: Room, or room label, that has the exit.

params.name: dir
params.doc: Direction of the exit.

methods.name: move_item
methods.doc: Moves an item to a room (at index), an actor's inventory, or a container.

params.doc: Item to move.

params.name: to
params.doc: Room or room label, actor, or container item.

params.name: index
params.doc: Track index when moving to a room.

methods.name: move_toward
methods.doc: Queues one step toward a direction, an actor (advancing within the room) or a room. False if there is no way.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that acts.

params.name: dir_or_target
params.doc: Direction, actor, or room (view or label) to head for.

methods.name: open_door
methods.doc: Opens the door in direction dir, even if locked.

params.name: room
params.doc: Room, or room label, that has the exit.

params.name: dir
params.doc: Direction of the exit.

methods.name: path_to
methods.doc: Directions from the owner's room to a room or actor through open exits; [] if already there, None if unreachable.

params.name: target
params.doc: Room, room label, or actor to reach.

methods.name: remove_affect
methods.doc: Removes an affect by name; True if there was one.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor carrying the affect.

params.name: name
params.doc: Affect name.

methods.name: roll
methods.doc: Rolls dice such as '2d6+1'.

params.doc: Dice expression such as '2d6+1'.

methods.name: say

params.name: text
params.doc: Text spoken.

methods.doc: Sends text to one actor.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor who receives the text.

params.name: text
params.doc: Text to send.

params.name: entity
params.doc: Actor, item or room.

params.name: reason

methods.name: set_anchor
methods.doc: Makes an entity project a bubble of its own, as players do, until its last reason is cleared.

params.name: entity
params.doc: Actor, item or room.

params.name: reason
params.doc: Name for this reason; clear_anchor with the same name removes it.

methods.name: set_attr
methods.doc: Stores a value (int, str, bool, list or dict) on an entity. None deletes the key.

params.name: entity
params.doc: Actor, item or room.

params.name: key
params.doc: Attribute key; unprefixed keys are in your package's namespace.

params.name: value
params.doc: Value to store (int, str, bool, list or dict), or None to delete the key.

params.doc: Room or room label, actor, or container item.

params.name: count
params.doc: Number to spawn; more than 1 returns a list.

params.doc: Stack to split.

params.name: n
params.doc: Number of items to split off.

params.name: a
params.doc: First actor.

params.name: b
params.doc: Second actor, in the same room.

methods.name: stop_combat
methods.doc: Ends combat between a and b, or all of a's fights when b is None.

params.name: a
params.doc: Actor whose fighting stops.

params.name: b
params.doc: Opponent, or None for all of a's fights.

methods.name: teleport
methods.doc: Moves an actor to a room; fires the exit and enter hooks.

params.doc: Actor to move.

params.name: room
params.doc: Destination room or room label.

params.name: index
params.doc: Track index on arrival, or None for the room's default.

methods.name: unlock_door
methods.doc: Unlocks the door, leaving it closed.

params.name: room
params.doc: Room, or room label, that has the exit.

params.name: dir
params.doc: Direction of the exit.

views.name: exit

fields.doc: The exit's direction name.

fields.name: entry_index
fields.doc: Destination track index where travellers arrive, or -1 for the back.

fields.name: key

fields.doc: True if this exit intentionally has no return exit.

fields.name: passable

fields.name: senses_blocked

fields.doc: The destination room's label.

ctx.name: rules_ctx

fields.name: actor

fields.name: band

fields.name: pulse

fields.name: rng
fields.doc: The seeded random number generator.

fields.name: room
fields.doc: The actor's room.

fields.doc: The other actor of the call, if any: the defender, the pinner, the victim, the killer.

methods.name: world
methods.doc: A fresh headless world with the given packages (default: this test's package) and the rules package. The spec's `load` argument is spelled `packages`, since load is a Starlark keyword (D-072). rules names another rules package to use instead of //rules. bubble=True keeps a reality bubble, so only rooms near players are simulated; by default every room is (D-116).

params.doc: Packages to load, or None for this test's package.

params.name: bubble
params.doc: True to simulate only rooms near players; by default every room is simulated.
